item.title: A Journey to AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
item.description: I passed the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) after about two weeks (~60 hours) of focused study. Not because the exam is trivial, but because mixing video, labs and gamified prep kept me moving. This post is the resource stack that worked for me (Udemy, Skill Builder, Cloud Quest, Escape Room) plus the Pearson VUE practicalities: extra time if English is not your first language, online proctoring, and the Credly badge.
